summary: st --instance NAME runs a second, fully separate install, and st uninstall removes everything st wrote, including the skill copies and the Claude plugin registration

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Without --instance or ST_INSTANCE every path, service name and label is unchanged. An instance keeps all of its state, sockets, executables and harness accounts under ~/.st-instance/NAME, with its own systemd unit and launchd label names; builds without this change ignore the flag and the variable. The default st uninstall now also removes the st skill copies it installed under ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills (only when unchanged), the Claude plugin and marketplace registration, and ~/.local/share/st/plugins; it still leaves workspaces, the account-wide lingering setting and the managed Claude Code policy.

downtime.detail: No migration or interruption. The default daemon and its services are not restarted.

manual.detail: Existing installs need no change. scripts/install, the release install.sh and the macOS installer accept --instance NAME, and never rewrite the default install's launchd plists.

recovery.detail: Nothing to undo. An instance is removed with st --instance NAME uninstall, which refuses to touch anything outside ~/.st-instance/NAME.
